claims: Catherine (2011) is a mature action-puzzle game by Atlus.
Vincent faces nightmares and relationship turmoil between his long-term girlfriend Katherine and a new lover Catherine.
Players climb block-based towers to survive in Catherine (2011).
Full Body (2019) is an enhanced version.
Catherine was originally released on July 25, 2011, for Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3.
Catherine is an action-adventure, puzzle, romantic thriller.
Players climb shifting block towers in Vincent's nightmares in Catherine.
Players escape monstrous manifestations of Vincent's fears in Catherine.
Full Body (2019) was released on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita.
Full Body (2019) features a third love interest named Rin.
Full Body was released on Nintendo Switch in 2020.
Catherine Classic is available on Steam.
